'''Jarenthi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3636 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] when former [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] [[Invasion of Ziost|came]] to the world and possessed many of the Imperials on the planet, turning them into his puppets to [[Death/Legends|murder]] civilians. Jarenthi was among those who fell under his control and he was killed during the fighting.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quartermaster Jarenthi was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' in game update 3.2.
